<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_ViennaNightRun"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/vienna-night-run">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_ViennaNightRun" name="App For Participating at the Vienna Night Run" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Process" name="Participation process starts"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectStartingBlock" name="Select starting block in the app"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RunFiveKm" name="Run 5 km"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MeasureTime" name="Measure time with fitness gadgets"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InitialTimeCheck" name="Under 25 minutes?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Train" name="Train"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckTime" name="Check time with fitness gadgets"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RepeatTimeCheck" name="Achieved the under-25-minute goal?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GetStartingNumber" name="Get starting number"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssessDepartureOption" name="Find out whether to go from home or leave from work"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DepartureChoice" name="More than one hour between workday end and starting time?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GoFromHome" name="Go to the Night Run from home"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_LeaveFromWork" name="Leave directly from work for the Night Run"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DepartureMerge" name="Merge departure routes"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RunDrinkSplit" name="Run and drink at the same time"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RunNightRun" name="Run at the Night Run"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DrinkDuringRun" name="Drink while running"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RunDrinkJoin" name="Finish running and drinking"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveFinalTime" name="Receive final running time"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Process" name="Final running time received"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Select" sourceRef="StartEvent_Process" targetRef="Task_SelectStartingBlock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Select_Run" sourceRef="Task_SelectStartingBlock" targetRef="Task_RunFiveKm"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Run_Measure" sourceRef="Task_RunFiveKm" targetRef="Task_MeasureTime"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Measure_InitialCheck" sourceRef="Task_MeasureTime" targetRef="Gateway_InitialTimeCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InitialCheck_Pass" name="Yes: less than 25 minutes" sourceRef="Gateway_InitialTimeCheck" targetRef="Task_GetStartingNumber">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">time < 25 minutes</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InitialCheck_Fail" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_InitialTimeCheck" targetRef="Task_Train"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Train_Check" sourceRef="Task_Train" targetRef="Task_CheckTime"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Check_RepeatGateway" sourceRef="Task_CheckTime" targetRef="Gateway_RepeatTimeCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RepeatCheck_Pass" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_RepeatTimeCheck" targetRef="Task_GetStartingNumber">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">time < 25 minutes</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RepeatCheck_Fail" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_RepeatTimeCheck" targetRef="Task_Train"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GetNumber_Assess" sourceRef="Task_GetStartingNumber" targetRef="Task_AssessDepartureOption"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Assess_DepartureChoice" sourceRef="Task_AssessDepartureOption" targetRef="Gateway_DepartureChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Departure_Home" name="More than one hour" sourceRef="Gateway_DepartureChoice" targetRef="Task_GoFromHome">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">starting time - workday end > 1 hour</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Departure_Work" name="One hour or less" sourceRef="Gateway_DepartureChoice" targetRef="Task_LeaveFromWork"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Home_Merge" sourceRef="Task_GoFromHome" targetRef="Gateway_DepartureMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Work_Merge" sourceRef="Task_LeaveFromWork" targetRef="Gateway_DepartureMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_RunDrink" sourceRef="Gateway_DepartureMerge" targetRef="Gateway_RunDrinkSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Run" sourceRef="Gateway_RunDrinkSplit" targetRef="Task_RunNightRun"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Drink" sourceRef="Gateway_RunDrinkSplit" targetRef="Task_DrinkDuringRun"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Run_Join" sourceRef="Task_RunNightRun" targetRef="Gateway_RunDrinkJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Drink_Join" sourceRef="Task_DrinkDuringRun" targetRef="Gateway_RunDrinkJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_Receive" sourceRef="Gateway_RunDrinkJoin" targetRef="Task_ReceiveFinalTime"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Receive_End" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveFinalTime" targetRef="EndEvent_Process"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
